description: This Java source file defines the main activity for an Android application demonstrating shortcuts. It includes setting up a ViewPager with tabs, managing fragment pages, and handling tab and page interactions.

classes.name: ShortcutLauncherMain
classes.description: Main activity class that manages a tabbed interface with a ViewPager, allowing users to switch between app list, pinned shortcuts, and shortcut creation screens.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the ViewPager, and configures the action bar tabs.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Overrides default back press behavior to ignore the back button.
